idea-plugin.name: Java Refactoring MCP Tools
idea-plugin.description:
Adds native Java refactoring operations to the IDE's built-in MCP Server, so AI coding agents can plan and execute real IDE refactorings through MCP instead of editing source text directly. Every write tool drives one native IntelliJ refactoring processor headlessly (no dialog), reports affected files, and stays reversible with exactly one Undo.
Exposes 24 Java tools: extract method, introduce variable / constant / field / parameter, change signature (add parameter), inline variable / method, safe delete, move class, move instance method, make static, convert to instance method, encapsulate fields, extract interface / superclass, pull members up / push members down, use interface where possible, introduce parameter object, replace method with method object, extract delegate, replace inheritance with delegation, plus a read-only symbol locator.
